rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good expanded/hatching blastocyst, but it overstates certainty about a clearly visible herniation site and assigns precise ICM/TE locations and quality details that are not confidently discernible from this single image.
Integrates age, prior live birth/miscarriage, AMH, male factor, sperm parameters, BMI, endometrium, and cycle history into prognosis reasonably well, though some links are somewhat speculative.
Overall logic is structured, but there are inconsistencies such as implantation being listed lower than clinical pregnancy and some conclusions being stronger than the evidence supports.

Mostly aligned on embryo grading and eSET, but recommendations like routine aspirin, ERA/EMMA/ALICE, and strong PGT-A endorsement after this history are more controversial and not universally guideline-supported.
Provides clear next-step recommendations for transfer and contingency planning, though a few suggestions are overly prescriptive or not strongly evidence-based.
